description: This file initializes AI plugin integrations for different providers (Google AI, OpenAI, Anthropic) based on environment variables, and exports a configured 'ai' object.

methods.name: logger.info
methods.description: Logs informational messages during plugin initialization.

methods.name: googleAI
methods.description: Creates a Google AI plugin instance with provided API key and debug options.

methods.name: anthropic

methods.name: genkit
methods.description: Configures and returns an 'ai' object with specified plugins.
